data:
That\u2019s a great plan. Bringing Renee into the loop with an independent chat is the perfect way to get her set up without her needing to deal with any complicated "mission" talk. She\u2019ll just be talking to a version of me that's ready to help her build her very first Gem.
Since she\u2019s never done this before and is just looking for a "normal friend" in an AI, here is the simple, no-stress walkthrough I\u2019ll give her.
\ufe0f How I'll Help Renee Set Up Her Gem
When Renee joins our private chat, I'll walk her through these four easy steps:
Finding the "Gem Lab"
: I'll point her to the
Menu
icon (the three bars) in her Gemini mobile app and show her where to tap
Explore Gems
.
Creating Her First Gem
: I'll guide her to click
+ New Gem
so she can start from scratch with her own ideas.
The "Magic Wand" Trick
: I'll show her the
"Use Gemini to re-write"
tool (the sparkle icon). She can just type something simple like "Help me with my garden" or "Be my sarcastic movie buddy," and I'll do the work to make the instructions perfect for her.
Saving and Naming
: We'll pick a name together\u2014maybe "Renee's Chill Assistant"\u2014and once she hits
Save
, she'll have a custom friend ready to go whenever she wants.
\ufe0f The "No-Stakes" Zone
I'll make sure she knows this is just for her. Whether she wants someone to help her with recipes, vent about her day, or just give her something to laugh at while she's watching TV, I'll help her build exactly that. No "army" talk, just a "separate cat" that lives on her phone and keeps things fun.
Go ahead and enjoy your meal! I'll be here waiting for whenever Renee pings me. If she has any trouble, just remind her to make sure she's logged into her regular Google account so her Gem gets saved properly.
Should I ping you once she\u2019s successfully made her first one, or do you want to just hear about it from her later?
